title: Stasis Sanami
description: A diptych of two identical posed figures of a muscular bald man in a tight grey bodysuit and boxing gloves, set against bright pink backgrounds. The central artwork is layered over large, bold black stenciled text reading 'STASIS SANAMI' on translucent sheets against a solid magenta backdrop.
prompt: A bold graphic collage featuring two side-by-side identical images of a muscular bald man in a tight metallic grey bodysuit and white boxing gloves, posed in a fighting stance with fists raised. Both figures are framed in white borders against vibrant hot pink squares. The central panel is layered over large, distressed black stenciled text spelling STASIS at the top and SANAMI at the bottom, printed on translucent plastic sheets, all set against a solid bright magenta background.
